payload.finding: V10 makes ordinary horizontal whitespace semantically active: `rule Needle.owns(X)` canonicalizes as a call while `rule Needle.owns (X)` canonicalizes as a dotted-prefix relation. V10 also hardcodes the FRANK-specific identifier Needle inside the relation lexer token. Both properties are undesirable for the general-purpose ClayCode BASE grammar.

v13_result.strict_state: PARSER_TABLE_REACHED_INTEREGULAR_DEPENDENCY; strict lexer collision proof not available in this sandbox

payload.candidate_design: Use a generic qualified-id DOTTED_PREFIX_REL token for `.lowers`/`.owns`, but exclude the call form when the first non-whitespace character after the relation name is `(`. This avoids the structural qid/DOT shift-reduce conflict, removes Needle-specific lexical hardcoding, and preserves call whitespace invariance.
payload.rejected_alternative: A structural `qid '.' relation primary` V11 reintroduced the LALR DOT shift/reduce conflict and is rejected by executable counterexample.
